evidence: app/package.json:9-11 — scripts define only build and start; no test runner anywhere in the app
app/src/api.mjs:53-90 — fetchJson dedupe/cache/error-eviction logic (the most failure-prone code) has zero tests
app/src/views.mjs:272-314 — sortRows/defaultCompare tie-breaking and missing-value handling untested
app/src/views.mjs:37-81 — getHomeData filter chaining, generation/type validation and page clamping untested
coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests were written at all, so none of the riskiest logic (caching semantics, sorting, URL state, error paths) is covered by anything the app owns.

evidence: app/src/api.mjs:17-47 — pure spec-definition helpers (humanize, formatDex, latestEnglishFlavorText) are exported and unit-testable but have no tests asserting their behaviour
app/src/render.mjs:82-89 — homeUrl's default-omission rules are pure and directly assertable, untested
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: The criterion anchors 'or no tests' at 1; there are no tests of any kind, behavioural or otherwise.

evidence: app/src/api.mjs:180-186 — getVersionGroup caches rejected promises permanently; a refactor or transient-API regression here has no guard and the failure is process-lifetime
app/src/views.mjs:306 — descending sort falls back to ascending tie-break (result || defaultCompare); no test would fail if someone 'fixed' or further broke it
app/server.mjs:53-55 — page parsing/clamping and invalid-filter semantics would regress silently
regression_power.rationale: With zero app-owned tests, nothing would fail if any covered behaviour broke once the acceptance suite stops being the only guard — and several behaviours are genuinely fragile.

evidence: app/package.json:14-18 — three runtime deps only; no devDependencies, no test infrastructure to carry padding
app/src/api.mjs:42,192 — dead exports (englishEffect, typeDisplayName) are the only 'noise', and they carry no test cost
signal_to_noise.rationale: Anchored at 3 for no tests: there is no noise, but also no signal.

findings.issue: getVersionGroup caches rejected promises in its own Map forever; unlike memoize (api.mjs:105-115) it never evicts on error, so one transient API failure permanently poisons that version group's moves section for the life of the process.
findings.suggestion: Evict on rejection the way memoize does, or reuse the memoize helper instead of a bespoke Map.

findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, and no test files exist in app/ despite the spec's hardest rules living in easily testable pure functions.
findings.suggestion: Add node:test (zero new deps) unit tests for api.mjs/render.mjs pure helpers: humanize, formatDex, formatValue, idFromUrl, latestEnglishFlavorText, homeUrl, sortRows, dedupeSortedPokemonEntries.

findings.issue: 404 responses are cached as null permanently, so a resource that 404s once (API restart mid-deploy, species added later) stays invisible until the process restarts, contradicting the spec's 'treat the API as live' framing.
findings.suggestion: Give negative cache entries a TTL, or skip caching 404s for resources the catalogs can rediscover.

findings.issue: sortRows falls back to defaultCompare (always ascending) on ties, so descending sort of equal keys is not the reverse of ascending; also uses a different collation than the explicit sort branch (views.mjs:303 pins 'en', the tie-break at views.mjs:286 does not).
findings.suggestion: Apply the direction to the tie-break too and pin the locale consistently; add a unit test with tied rows.

findings.issue: onError returns the 'Not found' page body with status 500, so an API outage is presented to users and support as a missing URL, and no test covers the error path.
findings.suggestion: Render a distinct error page (or at least a distinct h1) for 500s, and test it with a stubbed failing API.

findings.issue: Query-param normalization — page=abc/-1/9999 clamping (server.mjs:53-55, views.mjs:63-64) and invalid type/generation values silently yielding empty results (views.mjs:48-57) — is undefined and untested; a refactor could change these semantics invisibly.
findings.suggestion: Pin the clamping and invalid-filter behaviour with a few HTTP-level tests using fetch against the Hono app.

findings.issue: Height/weight are interpolated without formatValue, so a missing value renders 'NaN m' instead of the em-dash convention used everywhere else.
findings.suggestion: Route through formatValue (or an explicit null check) and add a fixture test for a Pokémon with null height/weight.

findings.issue: englishEffect and typeDisplayName (api.mjs:192) are exported but never used — dead code that invites untested divergence.
findings.suggestion: Delete them, or cover them if they are kept intentionally.

summary: The app ships zero tests of its own: no test script, runner, or files, even though its riskiest logic (caching semantics, sort tie-breaking, URL normalization, error paths) is precisely where acceptance tests stop. Reading that code reveals at least two real latent bugs — a permanently poisoned version-group cache and a 404-negative cache that never expires — plus a descending-sort tie-break inconsistency that nothing would ever catch. The spec's hardest rules live in small pure functions that would take a day to cover with dependency-free node:test suites.

untested.likelyBug: A transient API error permanently poisons a version group's moves section for the life of the process, and a once-404ed resource never becomes visible — the classic 'works until the first blip, then broken forever' failure that only shows up in production.
